response.description:
Wildcard domain support in Azure Firewall network rules is now
generally available. This capability enables customers to use wildcard
patterns, such as *.contoso.com, when
defining FQDN-based network rules. Wildcard support makes it easier to secure destinations that use
multiple or frequently changing subdomains. Customers can simplify policy
configuration, reduce the number of individual FQDN entries they need to
maintain, and manage access to related domains more efficiently. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Wildcard domain support in Azure Firewall network rules
